title: AE Agent Roadmap Supervisor Contract
purpose: Define the deterministic supervisor that can preview and run approved roadmap queue items while preserving the existing fail-closed SDK/conveyor safety model, including single-approval frozen queues for direct roadmap SDK writer children.

numberingDecision.reason: M198 was already occupied by the marker lifecycle live-validation lane in the active working tree.

approvalContract.approvalTextTemplate: I approve AE Agent roadmap supervisor repo=<absolute cwd> queue=<queue path> queueSha256=<sha256> itemIds=<comma-separated item ids> maxItems=<n> maxMinutes=<m> autoCommit=true noPush=true noDependencyChanges=true liveBindings=<bindings|none> noLiveCepAeUnlessPerItemApproved=true
binds: single-approval live bindings when generated-only live validation is explicitly declared
no live CEP/AE unless the selected item has its own approval or bound generated-only live approval

executionModel.roadmapSdkWriter: roadmap-sdk items run directly through orchestrator/codex-sdk-orchestrator.mjs with workspace-write, approval=never, web-search=disabled, reasoning=high, and model default. When --engine cli is selected, the roadmap-sdk writer itself uses codex exec through cmd.exe with equivalent workspace-write, approval never, high reasoning, web-search disabled, and no-network workspace policy, then returns to the same supervisor validation and commit gates.
executionModel.itemLiveValidation: Only when the queue item defines liveValidation. Generated-only commands either carry their own exact live approval text or are bound into the single supervisor approval with generatedOnlyLive=true and noUserAssetMutation=true.
executionModel.reviewerPolicy: read-only reviewers only; no parallel writers
executionModel.commitPolicy: auto-commit only planned paths after validation passes
